explication: This repository slice supplies Flutter media-kit’s platform-native libraries and video texture/rendering plugins; the Dart Player and VideoController implementation is outside the provided tree. The documented app workflow is to initialize media-kit, open media with Player, and display video through VideoController/Video. Native video managers create, resize, and dispose platform outputs; sampled source confirms manager-to-output calls on Android and Linux, and documents the Windows rendering worker/ANGLE relationship. Other platform wiring and audio-library internals are represented only at their documented package/platform level.
